name: evm-dev
description: Tells whether an ERC is final or an EIP is live on Ethereum mainnet, and writes Solidity contracts for the solc, OpenZeppelin, Foundry, and Hardhat versions a project uses, from dated items checked against the official documents

interface.longDescription: Answers whether an ERC is final or an EIP is live on Ethereum mainnet, and what it lets contracts and wallets do, and writes Solidity contracts in Foundry and Hardhat projects for the solc, OpenZeppelin, Foundry, and Hardhat versions the project uses. Both skills work from items checked against the official documents, each with the date it was checked and its source, and re-check items that are out of date. After writing, it scans the code for patterns that the project's versions changed or that no longer hold, such as tx.origin checks after EIP-7702, and builds and tests it. It never writes keys into files and never changes its items.
defaultPrompt: Is EIP-7702 live on Ethereum mainnet?
